prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve and style-transfer.
Asset: one transparent player avatar in the established warm Ukrainian board-game painted cat portrait series.
Input images: Image 1, the black-and-white photograph, is the ONLY human identity, face, hairstyle, expression, pose and clothing reference, Bohdan Buhyl. Image 2 supplies ONLY the approved gouache/colored-pencil medium, proper feline anatomy, contained bust framing and warm color finish. Do not copy image 2's face, big round eyes, hair volume, expression or overshirt/T-shirt outfit. Render the new portrait in the same muted natural warm color palette as the series, using the monochrome source to preserve shapes and tonal relationships.
Primary request: reimagine the man in image 1 as a recognizable anthropomorphic CAT. Preserve the long softly oval face, high broad forehead, slightly receding temples, slender jaw and rounded defined chin, straight fine eyebrows, original moderately narrow eye shape and spacing, friendly relaxed smile showing a little upper teeth, and natural smiling cheek creases. Clean-shaven appearance: no beard or moustache. Preserve natural adult proportions and his relaxed friendly expression, not a young wide-eyed cartoon or a muscular angular face. Real short natural feline muzzle, small elegant feline nose and fine whiskers; muted warm sandy/taupe fur with soft cream muzzle and cheek highlights.
Hair: short neatly combed dark brown hair with close sides, subtle side part and modest volume as in image 1; retain high/receding temple shape, no tall quiff, messy fringe or blond hair.
Anatomy: EXACTLY TWO pointed CAT ears TOTAL on TOP of the head, both fully inside the canvas with generous margin. Eye-level sides are continuous close fur and hair: NO human ears, side ears, fleshy lobes or extra lower ears.
Clothing: fully clothed light pale ivory/gray SHORT-SLEEVED BUTTON-UP SHIRT, not a polo or T-shirt, with small repeating gray geometric/floral dot-like motifs across the fabric, a short folded pointed collar, visible dark center buttons, contrasting tiny checked inner collar/placket trim and one chest patch pocket as in the source. The top button is casually open. No logos or lettering.
Style: detailed warm hand-painted gouache and colored pencil, softly dimensional textured fur, short hair and patterned cotton, warm brown outlines and ivory highlights, matching the established cat character series.
Composition: square canvas, one single centered head-and-upper-torso bust with slight three-quarter seated shoulder angle and face toward the viewer, naturally rounded lower shoulder silhouette; whole head, both ears and upper shoulders fully contained with generous transparent margins. Omit hands, elbows and lower body for consistent portrait framing.
Backdrop: genuine transparent alpha. Remove the cafe, chair, tables, umbrella, walls and ALL other people in the background. No props, other characters, scene, background circle, badge, frame, text or watermark.
